idea-plugin.name: Progress Tractor
idea-plugin.description:
Replaces the IDE's progress bars with a little tractor plowing a field.
  • Determinate progress: the plowed soil behind the tractor shows how much is done.
  • Indeterminate progress: the tractor drives back and forth across the field.
  • Drawn with Java2D, adapts to light and dark themes and HiDPI.
